Items: arrest confiscation.script: const N=v=>typeof v==='number'?v:Array.isArray(v)?v.reduce((a,b)=>a+N(b),0):(v&&typeof v==='object'?(typeof v.quantity==='number'?v.quantity:Object.values(v).reduce((a,b)=>a+N(b),0)):0);const C=["Trigger vial", "Handgun", "Katana", "Forged ID", "Tranquilizer pistol", "Combat knife", "Throwing knives", "Chain whip", "Brass knuckles", "Flashbang", "Smoke grenade", "Lockpick set"],got=[];for(const it of C){if(effects.length>=9)break;const n=N(check({type:'player-item',item:it}));if(n>0){effects.push({type:'item-remove',item:it,quantity:n});got.push(it);}}if(got.length){storage.seizeRest=C.slice(C.indexOf(got[got.length-1])+1);if(storage.seizeRest.length)effects.push({type:'write-boolean',key:'seizeMore',operator:'set',value:true});effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only: the police seize the character\'s '+got.join(', ')+' as evidence; none of it comes back.'});}else skip=true;
